questions.stem: Which of the following would increase the speed of a DC motor?

options.text: Increasing the number of turns on the coil
Reducing the number of turns on the coil

questions.explanation: Increasing the number of turns on the coil increases the force (F = BILn), which produces a greater torque and makes the motor spin faster. Increasing the current or using stronger magnets would also increase speed.

questions.stem: How can you reverse the direction of rotation of a DC motor?

options.text: Reverse either the current direction or the magnetic field direction, but not both
Add more turns to the coil

questions.explanation: Reversing either the current direction OR the magnetic field direction (but not both at the same time) will reverse the motor's rotation. If you reverse both, the direction of rotation remains the same.
